formal_object.rationale: The PSD generalized eigensystem solves a distance-ratio objective, not a bilinear score objective.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: A05: C=A^-1/2 B A^-1/2 is symmetric PSD. Condition: A invertible by rho I D01: Top eigenvectors of C maximize tr(V^T B V). Condition: Optimize the specified distance contrast

derivation.rationale: Whiten A and solve Bv=eta Av under v^TAv=1; expanding negative Mahalanobis distance yields 2qMc-cMc-qMq.

assumptions.rationale: rho>0; moments use only released fitting positives and explicit negatives. Generalized eigenvectors are A-orthonormal, V^T A V=I_k. Scientific score is negative Mahalanobis squared distance; bilinear similarity is a separate construction. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: A corrected distance construction is explicit. The legacy bilinear scorer omits candidate norms and is not certified by this derivation.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Any discrepancy between raw bilinear and distance rankings is driven by candidate metric-norm variation; the corrected distance need not improve hit@1. Falsification: Equal norm-corrected and bilinear rankings remove the mismatch for that scope. White covariance or supervised metric baselines matching the quality/cost defeat a new-method claim.

closest_alternative.rationale: Same-dimensional whitening and supervised metric learning can explain the geometry; no collision/novelty verdict is made. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
